from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Captures the essential identifying info of a legal document needed to filter by case cause."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or official name of the document as written")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The case cause (案由) stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
